## Description
This pull request creates a comprehensive README.md file in the `docs/` folder that serves as the central entry point for all OctoAcme project management process documentation.

  - Five-phase project lifecycle summary
  - Links to all seven detailed process documents
  - Quick-start guidance for different roles (PM, Product Manager, Developers)
  - Communication cadence overview
  - Information on contributing and proposing improvements
